summary: Adds project manifest version discovery and repairs the legacy updater bootstrap after proxy template consolidation.
highlights: dlux.utils.get_project_version(BASE_DIR) reads and trims the version from the project's release-manifest.json.
The helper can default to settings.BASE_DIR and returns an empty string for missing or malformed manifests.
Legacy enable-updater output reuses the shared maintenance page and exposes its read-only nginx status and log routes.
